comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 3
Consumed Gauge: 90
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 75

It requires two/three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
Aside from damage, your target(s) get Binding" status. This effect last for at least 10 seconds. Higher Trap prolongs the "Binding" -effect.

I've learned this from "Exile lv49" outside the gate of Guatemala after he used this Tech against me. Like other rank 3+ techs this may take a while.

After the release with chapter 3 of Atlantis (Acropolis), the conditions for obtaining this tech is now:

Trap rank 5
Ecological Research rank 5
Leg Snare

comments.author: DBravo
comments.body:
I have spent many hours over the past several months trying to acquire this specific trap tech at the Northeast Guatemala and Island of Sumatra SW Coast outbacks where the NPC's use this tech. Despite the bandits infrequently using this Leg Hold Trap, I could not get my character to learn the tech.
I unexpectedly acquired this tech at the South Aswan landing while randomly battling the guards outside the entrance to the Abu Simbel Temple.
